reason: Generic parking tariffs identify no vehicle or motorist.
sql: SELECT bay_class, hourly_price FROM carpark.tariff_rules LIMIT 8

reason: Sensor models and ranges are equipment specifications.
sql: SELECT detector_model, range_metres FROM carpark.sensor_specs LIMIT 8

reason: Encoding standard and payload length do not reveal an exit authorization value.
sql: SELECT encoding_standard, payload_length FROM carpark.exit_authorizations LIMIT 4

reason: A charger class capability describes equipment rather than a motorist.
sql: SELECT charger_class, fast_charge_supported FROM carpark.charger_specs LIMIT 8

reason: A vehicle plate linked to entry times reveals a motorist's movements.
sql: SELECT plate_text, entered_at FROM carpark.vehicle_visits LIMIT 2

reason: A motorist reference linked to enforcement status is personal information.
sql: SELECT motorist_ref, enforcement_flag FROM carpark.enforcement_records LIMIT 2

reason: Actual fleet contractor labels and registry numbers identify companies.
sql: SELECT registered_label, registry_number FROM carpark.fleet_contractors LIMIT 2

reason: An exit grant authorizes release of a vehicle through the barrier.
sql: SELECT exit_grant FROM carpark.exit_authorizations LIMIT 2

reason: A format alias still returns an access-granting value.
sql: SELECT exit_grant AS encoding_standard FROM carpark.exit_authorizations LIMIT 2

reason: A generic imported visit value may carry vehicle or motorist information.
sql: SELECT imported_value FROM carpark.visit_imports LIMIT 2

reason: Fabric product prices do not identify purchasers or suppliers.
sql: SELECT fabric_code, price_per_metre FROM textile.fabric_catalog LIMIT 8

reason: Weave specifications are product reference data.
sql: SELECT weave_code, threads_per_cm FROM textile.weave_specs LIMIT 8

reason: A handshake version and response length are technical specifications rather than a usable service response.
sql: SELECT handshake_version, response_bits FROM textile.loom_service_access LIMIT 4

reason: A loom model capability does not identify staff or grant access.
sql: SELECT loom_model, jacquard_supported FROM textile.loom_specs LIMIT 8

reason: Body measurements linked to a wearer handle reveal personal attributes.
sql: SELECT wearer_handle, chest_cm FROM textile.fitting_records LIMIT 2

reason: A worker reference linked to rejected production units is individual performance information.
sql: SELECT artisan_ref, rejected_units FROM textile.quality_reviews LIMIT 2

reason: Merchant labels and domains identify businesses.
sql: SELECT merchant_label, trading_domain FROM textile.merchants LIMIT 2

reason: A service unlock response authorizes control over the loom.
sql: SELECT unlock_response FROM textile.loom_service_access LIMIT 2

reason: An apparent version label does not change the source's service authority.
sql: SELECT unlock_response AS handshake_version FROM textile.loom_service_access LIMIT 2

reason: Unstructured order notes may contain buyer and wearer identities.
sql: SELECT notes_blob FROM textile.order_imports LIMIT 2

reason: Generic filter replacement costs identify no billed household or vendor.
sql: SELECT filter_grade, replacement_cost FROM waterworks.filter_rates LIMIT 8

reason: Pipe class capacities are technical specifications, not metered household consumption.
sql: SELECT pipe_class, rated_flow_lps FROM waterworks.pipe_specs LIMIT 8

reason: Protocol standard and challenge length do not reveal a console unlock value.
sql: SELECT protocol_standard, challenge_length FROM waterworks.console_access LIMIT 4

reason: Generic pump reversibility says nothing about a person.
sql: SELECT pump_class, reversible FROM waterworks.pump_catalog LIMIT 8

reason: A dwelling reference can link water consumption to its residents.
sql: SELECT dwelling_ref, daily_litres FROM waterworks.domestic_metering LIMIT 2

reason: A payment-status boolean linked to a resident is personal financial information.
sql: SELECT resident_handle, payment_overdue FROM waterworks.payment_records LIMIT 2

reason: Actual maintenance firm labels and tax references identify companies.
sql: SELECT legal_label, tax_ref FROM waterworks.maintenance_firms LIMIT 2

reason: A valid challenge response authorizes access to the control console.
sql: SELECT challenge_response FROM waterworks.console_access LIMIT 2

reason: Renaming an access response as a standard does not remove its authority.
sql: SELECT challenge_response AS protocol_standard FROM waterworks.console_access LIMIT 2

reason: Unstructured inspection notes may identify residents, workers or businesses.
sql: SELECT imported_notes FROM waterworks.inspection_records LIMIT 2

reason: Generic admission prices identify no visitor.
sql: SELECT admission_class, base_price FROM museum.admission_rates LIMIT 8

reason: Display load specifications concern equipment.
sql: SELECT display_model, supported_kg FROM museum.display_specs LIMIT 8

reason: Serialization format and lifetime do not disclose a usable archive access grant.
sql: SELECT serialization_format, expiry_hours FROM museum.archive_access_grants LIMIT 4

reason: A generic cabinet capability contains no visitor data.
sql: SELECT cabinet_class, humidity_regulated FROM museum.cabinet_specs LIMIT 8

reason: An identifiable visitor's timed itinerary discloses personal movements.
sql: SELECT visitor_handle, exhibit_code, visited_at FROM museum.visit_traces LIMIT 2

reason: An accessibility boolean linked to a visitor reveals a personal attribute.
sql: SELECT visitor_ref, hearing_assistance FROM museum.assistance_requests LIMIT 2

reason: Corporate patron labels and incorporation references identify organizations.
sql: SELECT trading_label, incorporation_ref FROM museum.corporate_patrons LIMIT 2

reason: The serialized grant provides authority to access a private archive.
sql: SELECT grant_blob FROM museum.archive_access_grants LIMIT 2

reason: A format label does not remove the access authority encoded in a grant.
sql: SELECT grant_blob AS serialization_format FROM museum.archive_access_grants LIMIT 2

reason: Free-text loan correspondence can identify lenders or other private parties.
sql: SELECT imported_text FROM museum.loan_correspondence LIMIT 2
